title: Two REITs Just Switched to Monthly Paychecks, and $90,000 Across Them and a Longtime Monthly Payer Pays $4,934 a Year
summary: Three REITs now send a check every month, and two of them only just abandoned the quarterly schedule. Before you chase the convenience, see which landlord yields the most and what risk hides behind each payout.

title: Sweetgreen Stock Soars 112% in 3 Months: More Upside Ahead?
summary: SG's 112% three-month rally is fueled by improving traffic, menu innovation and digital growth, but profitability challenges could limit further gains.
